scientific_integrity: Claims rest on a self-contained heat-kernel asymptotic proof; finite exact and numeric tests only corroborate calculations, not the infinite limits. The same-model review is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact polynomially tilted critical-geometric initial distributions with fixed drift and fixed beta; no unrestricted slowly varying factors, no full conditioned path theorem, no quantitative rates. Historical priority may involve general killed-kernel ratio-limit results.
title: Survival-conditioned entrance localization across the critical tail boundary
